question: Build Duro Walton’s source-wide VOC/HAP register. Are the revised PTE figures or 2019 actual emissions the enforceable permit ceilings?
answer: F-22-015 requires source-wide VOC no greater than 60 tons, single HAP no greater than 9 tons and combined HAP no greater than 22.5 tons, using consecutive rolling twelve-month totals. Monthly emissions are calculated and added to the previous eleven months; they are not calendar-year-only totals or separate allowances per press. The basis summary shows VOC 2019 actual 21.64 tpy, previous unrestricted PTE 174.352 and revised PTE 144.854; combined HAP 2019 actual 1.073 and revised PTE 58.56. Those table columns do not replace final enforceable caps or prove an observed exceedance. The basis explicitly says PTE excludes self-imposed limitations and explains caps preclude Title V/major-HAP status; the permit is conditional major operating under 401 KAR 52:030, not an admitted Title V permit. Obtain actual monthly balances and certifications to evaluate compliance.

question: Register Duro’s emergency-engine hours, maintenance and air-transfer conditions. Can the emergency exemption or administrative amendment remove all requirements?
answer: F01 is the 430 HP diesel fire pump and EG1 the 130 HP propane generator. The permit allows unlimited emergency use, but maintenance/readiness testing is limited to 100 hours per year; up to 50 non-emergency hours count within that 100, not an additional 50. Oil/filter and hoses/belts are checked every 500 operating hours or annually, whichever first; air cleaner every 1,000 hours or annually. Hour meters and separate emergency/non-emergency logs remain required. Emergency-delay relief is conditional and requires reporting; oil analysis is an explicit conditional alternative. The basis exempts these units from IIII/JJJJ by construction date but retains ZZZZ. Future owners/operators must obtain a new permit; an administrative amendment route requires a written transfer-responsibility/liability agreement submitted within ten days following transfer, not ten days before. No actual transfer or current compliance is established.
